title: MVP — prove the stack, then build the spine
content:
Phase 0 proves the three unverified integrations. Then one vertical slice through rounds and stage configuration establishes every pattern in codebase-structure.md — module layout, ports, Result types, HTTP-only tests at 100%, OpenAPI generation, deploy — before the other eight modules are built against it.

Configuration before applicant experience. Building the applicant flow first reliably produces hardcoded stages that then have to be torn out.
